stemMd: A positive fraction is 3/7. The same positive number is added to its numerator and denominator. The resulting fraction must be what?
explanationMd: For t>0, (3+t)/(7+t) exceeds 3/7 because 7(3+t)>3(7+t). The denominator still exceeds the numerator, so the fraction remains below 1.

distractorRationale.a: Adding the same positive amount moves this proper fraction towards 1.
distractorRationale.c: The numerator and denominator remain unequal.
distractorRationale.b: Equal addition is not equal scaling.
